user.title: Spiel Saison
user.description: Connection to the app “Spiel Saison Recorder” and the folder of the recordings. The address is shown on the app page under “Info → Hostname”, the key is the `api_key` from the app settings. Recordings go into the app folder under: base folder / folder per play partner / folder per season / file per camera. In the patterns you can use the placeholders partner, nr, saison, aufnahme, cam, cam_nr and ort, each in curly braces (cam and cam_nr only in the file name), plus date and time with %CCYY %MM %DD %hh %mm %ss.

user.title: New play partner
user.description: Every play partner has their own seasons, counters and folder. The cameras belong to the places you add for them afterwards. The number appears in the folder and the file name, for example as 02. The nickname is optional. For the preferences you type your own entries and confirm each with Enter. Everything you ever entered is offered for every further play partner. Every preference gets an entry under “Diagnostic” on the play partner's device. Preferences for working also get an “included” switch and a counter. The announcement is optional: it goes through a notify entity, for example an Echo, when a recording starts and ends. In the texts you can use the placeholders nickname, partner, nr, saison and ort, each in curly braces. Under “Lights” you choose the lights this play partner may adjust. They appear on the partner's device, where they are set the way the play partner likes best and saved with the “Save lighting” button. With the first recording of every season this lighting is set again.

data.lights: Lights the play partner may adjust (they appear on the partner's device)

reconfigure.title: Edit play partner
reconfigure.description: Change name, number, nickname, preferences and announcement. New preferences get their entries on the device when you save, removed ones disappear there. Below you find the counters Season, Recordings in season and Recordings total. You can only change them here, and only what you change is applied. With the switches below you set the recording time in the season, the recording time total and the longest recording in the season to zero. Existing recordings stay in their folder, new ones go to the folder with the changed name. The cameras are set at the places. In the announcements you can use the placeholders nickname, partner, nr, saison and ort, each in curly braces. Under “Lights” you choose the lights this play partner may adjust. They appear on the partner's device, where they are set the way the play partner likes best and saved with the “Save lighting” button. With the first recording of every season this lighting is set again.

user.title: New place
user.description: A place is where a play partner plays, for example bed or swing. It brings the cameras that record there. On start the integration moves the Ctronics cameras to their PTZ position, switches lights and devices and waits for the lead time before the recording begins. On end it waits for the pause and puts everything back. The next step lets you choose the PTZ position for every Ctronics camera, then optionally the position of the winch, then what is switched for “Start recording” and “End recording”. The other settings of “Prepare season” and “End season” are under “Configure” of the integration.

data.name: Name
data.lead_seconds: Lead time between “Start recording” and the recording
data.end_seconds: Pause between the end of the recording and “End recording”

user_ptz.title: PTZ position per camera
user_ptz.description: For each Ctronics camera of this place you choose the stored position it moves to on start. The names come from the options of the Ctronics 4K Cam integration. Without names the numbers 1 to 64 are offered. “Do not move” leaves the camera where it is. Other cameras are not moved and do not appear here.

user_cover.title: Position of the winch
user_cover.description: Optional. You choose the winch under “Configure” of the integration. “Prepare season” moves it only to the position under “Configure”. The position you give here (0 to 100 percent) is where the winch moves when you start the recording at this place, before the recording begins. If you leave the field empty, the winch stays where it is.

data.cover_position: Position of the winch when the recording starts (0 to 100)

user_begin.title: Start recording
user_begin.description: Applies when a recording starts. Everything is optional. You can choose entities, devices, areas or labels, also scenes and scripts. For “Start recording” the targets under “Turn off” are turned off first, then the ones under “Turn on” are turned on.

user_end.title: End recording
user_end.description: Applies when a recording ends. Everything is optional. After the pause the targets under “Turn off” are turned off first, then the ones under “Turn on” are turned on. Only the “Save place” button saves the place.

init.title: Prepare season
init.description: Applies only to the “Prepare season” button and the service of the same name, the same for all play partners and places, not to the recording. Everything is optional. You can choose entities, devices, areas or labels, also scenes and scripts. The button turns off the targets under “Turn off” first, then turns on the ones under “Turn on”, then turns on the lights and finally moves the cover, winch or similar to the position. The position a place has is approached only when a recording starts, not here. If you choose lights, a page for their colour and brightness follows.

data.lights: Turn on lights (colour and brightness on the next page)

prepare_lights.title: Prepare season: lights
prepare_lights.description: Choose the colour and the brightness (in percent) each light is turned on with. If you leave a field empty, the light comes on as it was last. The light first comes on with the brightness, and after 2 seconds the colour follows as a command of its own. A white or grey (almost no colour) is sent to the lamp as a colour temperature.

finish.title: End season
finish.description: Applies only to the “End season” button and the service of the same name, the same for all play partners and places, not to the recording. Everything is optional. You can choose entities, devices, areas or labels, also scenes and scripts. Order: the cover or winch moves first (it still needs power for that), then the targets under “Turn off” are turned off, the ones under “Turn on” are turned on and the lights are turned on. Finally the button waits for the end switch and only then turns off the targets under “Turn off once the end switch is on”, for example the winch. If the end switch does not come on in time, they stay on and the button reports an error. If an “up” switch and an end switch are chosen, the button drives the winch with that switch up to the end switch instead of to the position, and turns it off afterwards. After the time estimate alone the winch often stops just short of the end switch. If you choose lights, a page for their colour and brightness follows. Everything is saved when you submit the last page.

start_recording.name: Start recording
start_recording.description: Starts the recording of a play partner: the winch moves to the position of the place (if it has one), then “Start recording” of the place runs, then the lead time and the recording.

place.name: Place
place.description: Name of the place of this play partner. Without it the place chosen on the play partner's device is used.

stop_recording.name: Stop recording
stop_recording.description: Stops the recording of a play partner and then runs the end step of the place.

prepare.name: Prepare season
prepare.description: Begins the season of the day if there is none for today yet, creates the folder of the season in the target folder if it is missing, and runs the “Prepare season” settings (under “Configure” of the integration): turn targets off and on, turn lights on with their colour, move the cover or winch. Nothing is recorded.

place.name: Place
place.description: Name of a place of this play partner, it only fills the placeholder “ort” of the folder patterns. Without it the place chosen on the play partner's device is used.

new_season.name: Start new season
new_season.description: Raises the season number of a play partner and resets the counters and the statistics of the season. This works only once a day: if there is already a season for today, nothing changes.

end_season.name: End season
end_season.description: Runs the “End season” settings (under “Configure” of the integration): move the cover or winch, turn targets off and on, turn lights on with their colour, then wait for the end switch and only then turn off the targets “Turn off once the end switch is on”. This works only while no recording is running for the play partner.

save_lighting.name: Save lighting
save_lighting.description: Saves the lighting of a play partner as it is now: for each of the lights they may adjust whether it is on, the colour and the brightness. With the first recording of every season this lighting is set again.
